feeds.title: Veterinary Dentistry Specialists News
feeds.description: Veterinary Dentistry Specialists (VDS) is the only dedicated veterinary dental practice in the United States staffed by a board-certified veterinary dentistry specialist and a board-certified veterinary anesthesiologist at all times during business hours. This means your pet benefits from an exceptional level of clinical expertise when advanced dental care and oral surgery are needed.

feeds.title: Veterinary Dental Services Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're seeking advanced veterinary dental services for a patient or for your own pet, Veterinary Dental Services truly is the right place for you. Our veterinarians have been providing state-of-the-art veterinary dental care and oral surgery in Massachusetts for almost 20 years while keeping the safety and comfort of our patients at the forefront.

feeds.title: Veterinary Dentistry Specialists Blog
feeds.description: Veterinary Dental Specialties and Oral Surgery (VDS) is the premier center of excellence for your animal's oral care. We do oral care and nothing else on dogs, cats, and exotics nationally and internationally! In veterinary medicine, pet dental care is still too often considered a nice-to-have. Yet oral health is the gateway - and often a predictor- of overall animal health. We are on a mission to bring the best, most comprehensive, and cutting-edge oral health care to animals and their pet parents everywhere.

feeds.title: Animal Dentistry Solutions
feeds.description: In 1996, Dr. DeForge was honored as AAHA North East Practitioner of the Year He also received the Peter Emily Residents Award in Small Animal Dentistry. He writes and updates Animal Dentistry Solutions Blog where he provides various tips and cure for your animals from his experiences

feeds.title: Midwestern Veterinary Dentistry and Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Learn efficient and effective techniques for treating your patients through training programs that are created specifically for you and your team. With more than 30 years of expertise, we are confident that we can provide you with the skills, knowledge, and ongoing guidance that will translate into immediate benefits for your patients.

feeds.title: Houndstooth Teeth Cleaning Blog
feeds.description: At Houndstooth, all of our cleaners are chosen for their prior experience working closely with dogs. We want to provide the best possible service to our clients, so we sought out training from professionals specializing in this field. We believe that every pet deserves the best of care. That's why we strive to offer high-quality pet teeth cleaning services. Pets are an essential part of many people's lives and keeping them healthy is a top priority.

feeds.title: Montana Pet Dentistry & Oral Surgery Blog
feeds.description: At Montana Pet Dentistry and Oral Surgery, your pet's oral health and comfort are extremely important to us. Dental problems are more common in pets than owners realize and can cause severe pain if left untreated. When your dog or cat is suffering from a dental issue, a board-certified vet dentistTM is the most qualified person to call.

feeds.title: Your Pet Dentist Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Greenfield's extensive experience in treating not only periodontal disease, but also endodontics (root canal therapy, cracked teeth), orthodontics, prosthodontics (crowns & cosmetic dentistry), surgical oncology (oral tumors), and other pet dental services allows him to receive referrals from a wide area. He also accepts non-referrals for annual dental prevention and cleaning procedures.

feeds.title: Southeast Veterinary Dentistry Blog
feeds.description: Our Board-Certified veterinary dentist and oral surgeon has over 30 years of experience and can provide you with the skills, knowledge, and ongoing guidance that translates into immediate benefits for your patients. Learn the most efficient and effective techniques for treating your patients through training programs that are created specifically for you and your team.

feeds.title: Apex Veterinary Specialty Blog
feeds.description: Apex Veterinary Specialty Services, located at the Veterinary Referral Center of Colorado (VRCC), is a progressive dentistry, oral surgery, dermatology, and ophthalmology center that provides compassionate care for veterinary patients. Our board-certified veterinary specialists & highly-trained staff are dedicated to working closely with both the pet parent and family veterinarian.

feeds.title: The Vet Dentists
feeds.description: As veterinary dentists, we specialize in advanced pet dental care, oral surgery, and pet dental health education. Our experts are a nationwide group of board-certified veterinary dentists who work together to provide the best in veterinary dental care to pets, increase access to veterinary dental information, and further pet dental health education to pet families across the country.

feeds.title: Godspeed Animal Care Blog
feeds.description: Godspeed Animal Care is an American Animal Hospital Association (AAHA) accredited hospital offering veterinary services to dogs and cats in the Williamsburg, Virginia area. The highly trained veterinarians at Godspeed Animal Care treat your pet as their own.

feeds.title: Carefree Animal Dental Blog
feeds.description: For those discerning pet owners who require state-of-the-art dental and oral surgical care Carefree Dentistry and Oral Surgery for Animals is the place to be. Our doctors have had years of extensive and advanced training in veterinary dentistry, oral surgery, and anesthesia. We focus entirely on dentistry and oral surgery therefore we have become nationally recognized (board-certifiedTM) in our skills and knowledge.

feeds.title: Animal Dental Care & Oral Surgery Blog
feeds.description: We are dedicated and passionate about providing cutting-edge dental and oral care. Your companion is in the hands of board-certified veterinary dentists who specialize in the field of veterinary dentistry and oral surgery. We treat pet dental trauma, and mouth wounds and offer same-day emergency appointments.
